title_en: The family is coming to visit
summary_en: Sofie tells her friend Emil about a family birthday gathering.

lines.speaker: Emil
lines.da: Hvad skal du lave på søndag?
lines.en: What are you doing on Sunday?

lines.speaker: Sofie
lines.da: Min familie kommer på besøg. Min mor har fødselsdag.
lines.en: My family is coming to visit. It is my mother's birthday.

lines.speaker: Sofie
lines.da: Vi bliver tolv. Mine forældre, mine søskende og deres børn.
lines.en: There will be twelve of us. My parents, my siblings and their children.

lines.speaker: Emil
lines.en: How many siblings do you have?

lines.speaker: Sofie
lines.da: Jeg har en storebror og en lillesøster.
lines.en: I have an older brother and a younger sister.

lines.speaker: Emil
lines.en: Do they also live in Aarhus?

lines.speaker: Sofie
lines.da: Min bror gør, men min søster bor i Odense.
lines.en: My brother does, but my sister lives in Odense.

lines.speaker: Sofie
lines.da: Ja, hun har en lille datter. Hun er to år.
lines.en: Yes, she has a little daughter. She is two years old.

lines.speaker: Emil
lines.da: Det bliver hyggeligt at se hende.
lines.en: It will be lovely to see her.

lines.speaker: Sofie
lines.da: Ja, jeg savner hende. Hun er så sjov.
lines.en: Yes, I miss her. She is so funny.

lines.speaker: Sofie
lines.da: Min mormor kommer. Hun glæder sig meget.
lines.en: My maternal grandmother is coming. She is really looking forward to it.

lines.speaker: Emil
lines.da: Hils din mor, og sig til lykke fra mig.
lines.en: Give your mother my regards and wish her a happy birthday from me.
